answer_1.quote: The task also requires a consideration of the naturalness of a text when filling the blank, which is necessary for applications of generating text with antonyms.

answer_2.quote: We used top-1 and top-10 accuracy values as the measures for the correctness of model predictions.

answer_4.quote: To investigate such cases with multiple possible correct words, we conducted a subjective evaluation of the quality of the answers of the human subjects and the proposed method (with the participation of another human subject).
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators judged predictions for contrastiveness and naturalness (fluency).
